targets.query:
from(bucket: "temi")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "robot_events" and r.event_type == "wave" and r._field == "count")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: 1h, fn: sum, createEmpty: true)
  |> fill(value: 0)
  |> yield(name: "waves")

from(bucket: "temi")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "robot_events" and r._field == "count")
  |> group(columns: ["event_type"])
  |> aggregateWindow(every: 1h, fn: sum, createEmpty: true)
  |> fill(value: 0)
  |> yield(name: "events")

from(bucket: "temi")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "conversations" and r._field == "duration_s")
  |> group()
  |> mean()
  |> yield(name: "avg_duration")

from(bucket: "temi")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "conversations" and r._field == "duration_s")
  |> group()
  |> count()
  |> yield(name: "conversations")

from(bucket: "temi")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "conversations" and r._field == "duration_s")
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({ r with theme:
        if exists r.topic and r.topic == "directions" then "Directions"
        else if exists r.topic and r.topic == "library" then "Bibliothèque"
        else if exists r.topic and r.topic == "clubs" then "Clubs / CCA"
        else if exists r.topic and r.topic == "admin" then "Admin / Inscription"
        else if exists r.topic and r.topic == "facilities" then "Installations"
        else "Autre" }))
  |> group(columns: ["theme"])
  |> count(column: "_value")
  |> keep(columns: ["theme", "_value"])
  |> yield(name: "by_topic")

from(bucket: "temi")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "conversations" and r._field == "duration_s")
  |> group()
  |> aggregateWindow(every: 1d, fn: count, createEmpty: true)
  |> fill(value: 0)
  |> yield(name: "conversations_per_day")

from(bucket: "temi")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "conversation_logs" and (r._field == "question" or r._field == "answer"))
  |> pivot(rowKey: ["_time", "session_id", "topic"], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value")
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "session_id", "topic", "question", "answer"])
  |> sort(columns: ["_time"], desc: true)
